name: PaperQA2
description: Agentic RAG over scientific papers and other documents that produces answers grounded in cited passages.
whatItDoes: Answers questions, summarises and checks for contradictions across a folder of PDFs, text, Office documents or source files, with a focus on scientific literature. It is used by researchers who need high-accuracy, cited answers.
howItWorks: An agent searches the indexed papers, gathers evidence by summarising and re-ranking relevant chunks, and then writes an answer with in-text citations. Paper metadata can be enriched from Crossref and Semantic Scholar. Models are routed through LiteLLM, and it is used through the pqa command or as a Python library.
models: Any LiteLLM-supported model, including local Ollama models
